name: worktrees
description: Cursor git worktree configuration — sets up project-local worktree storage with symlinks and setup hooks
author: Pennymac AI Platform

prompts.name: setup
prompts.description: Configure Cursor git worktrees to use a project-local .worktrees/ directory with a symlink from ~/.cursor/worktrees/

parameters.name: projectRoot
parameters.description: Absolute path to the project root directory. Defaults to the current workspace root.

parameters.name: setupCommands
parameters.description: Shell commands to run when a new worktree is created (e.g., dependency installation). Auto-detected from project files if not provided.

returns.description: Summary of the worktree configuration that was applied

projectName.description: The project directory name used for the symlink

symlinkCreated.description: Whether a new symlink was created

worktreesMigrated.description: Number of existing worktrees that were migrated from the global directory

setupCommands.description: The setup commands written to worktrees.json

throws.title: NotAGitRepoError
throws.description: The target directory is not a git repository

throws.title: MigrationError
throws.description: Existing worktree contents could not be moved to the local directory

throws.title: SymlinkConflictError
throws.description: The global worktree path is already a symlink pointing to a different location

examples.description: Set up worktrees for current project with auto-detected setup commands
Set up worktrees with explicit setup commands

prompts.name: create
prompts.description: Create a new git worktree in the project-local .worktrees/ directory, optionally creating a new feature branch (via the detached-HEAD-first technique), and run worktrees.json setup hooks

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: An existing branch name, tag, or commit SHA to check out in the worktree. Mutually exclusive with newBranch and detach.

parameters.name: newBranch
parameters.description: Name of a new feature branch to create in the worktree. Created with the detached-HEAD-first technique: the worktree is created detached, then the branch is created inside it, with automatic rollback if branch creation fails. Follow the feature/{environment}/{feature-name} convention where applicable. Mutually exclusive with branch and detach.

parameters.name: startPoint
parameters.description: Base commit/branch/tag the new branch or detached worktree starts from. Defaults to the current HEAD. Only meaningful with newBranch, detach, or the default (dir-named) branch mode.

parameters.name: detach
parameters.description: Create the worktree at a detached HEAD with no branch. Mutually exclusive with branch and newBranch.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Short name for the worktree directory inside .worktrees/. Auto-derived from branch if not provided.

parameters.name: skipSetup
parameters.description: Skip running worktrees.json setup commands after creation.

worktreePath.description: Full absolute path to the new worktree directory

branch.description: The branch checked out in the worktree

newBranch.description: Whether a new branch was created

setupResults.description: Results of each setup command that was run

throws.title: WorktreesNotConfiguredError
throws.description: The project does not have .worktrees/ set up with the symlink

throws.title: WorktreeExistsError
throws.description: A worktree directory with the requested name already exists

throws.title: BranchInUseError
throws.description: The branch is already checked out in another worktree

throws.title: BranchExistsError
throws.description: The requested new branch name already exists (the partial detached worktree is rolled back before this is returned)

throws.title: GitCommandError
throws.description: The git worktree add command failed

examples.description: Create a worktree on a new feature branch (detached-HEAD-first)
Create a worktree from an existing branch
Create a worktree with a custom name, skipping setup

prompts.name: remove
prompts.description: Remove a git worktree by name or path, cleaning up the directory and git metadata. Lists available worktrees if no name is provided.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name or path of the worktree to remove. If omitted, lists available worktrees for selection.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force removal even if the worktree has uncommitted changes.

worktreePath.description: Full path of the removed worktree

worktreeName.description: The directory name that was removed

branch.description: The branch that was checked out in the removed worktree

throws.title: WorktreeNotFoundError
throws.description: No worktree matches the provided name

throws.title: MainWorktreeError
throws.description: The user attempted to remove the main working tree

throws.title: RemovalFailedError
throws.description: The git worktree remove command failed even with --force

examples.description: Force remove a worktree with uncommitted changes

prompts.name: merge
prompts.description: Merge a worktree's branch into a target branch, with optional worktree cleanup after successful merge

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name or path of the worktree whose branch will be merged. If omitted, lists available worktrees for selection.

parameters.name: targetBranch
parameters.description: The branch to merge into (e.g., 'main', 'develop'). Must be an existing branch.

parameters.name: noFastForward
parameters.description: Create a merge commit even when fast-forward is possible.

parameters.name: deleteAfterMerge
parameters.description: Remove the worktree after a successful merge.

sourceBranch.description: The branch that was merged from (the worktree's branch)

targetBranch.description: The branch that was merged into

mergeCommit.description: The merge commit SHA, or null if fast-forward

fastForward.description: Whether the merge was a fast-forward

worktreeRemoved.description: Whether the worktree was removed after merge

throws.title: WorktreeNotFoundError
throws.description: No worktree matches the provided name

throws.title: TargetBranchNotFoundError
throws.description: The specified target branch does not exist

throws.title: MergeConflictError
throws.description: The merge produced conflicts requiring manual resolution

mergeLocation.description: Path where the merge is in progress

throws.title: SameBranchError
throws.description: The source and target branches are identical

examples.description: Merge a feature worktree into main
Fast-forward merge and remove the worktree

prompts.name: update
prompts.description: Update a worktree's branch to include changes from another branch using merge or rebase

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name or path of the worktree to update. If omitted, lists available worktrees for selection.

parameters.name: sourceBranch
parameters.description: The branch to pull changes from. Defaults to the repository's default branch (main or master).

parameters.name: strategy
parameters.description: How to incorporate changes: 'merge' creates a merge commit, 'rebase' replays commits on top of the source.

parameters.name: fetch
parameters.description: Fetch from remote before updating to ensure the source branch is current.

worktreeName.description: Name of the worktree that was updated

sourceBranch.description: The branch changes were pulled from

stashRestored.description: Whether uncommitted changes were stashed and restored

throws.title: WorktreeNotFoundError
throws.description: No worktree matches the provided name

throws.title: SourceBranchNotFoundError
throws.description: The specified source branch does not exist

throws.title: MergeConflictError
throws.description: The merge or rebase produced conflicts requiring manual resolution

throws.title: DetachedHeadError
throws.description: The worktree is in detached HEAD state

examples.description: Rebase a feature worktree onto main (default)

prompts.name: switch
prompts.description: Switch the active workspace to a different git worktree. Inside Cursor, uses the cursor-app-control MCP to redirect the UI; outside Cursor, prints the cd command for manual use.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name, path, or branch of the worktree to switch to. If omitted, lists available worktrees for selection.

returns.description: Details of the worktree switch operation

worktreePath.description: Full absolute path to the worktree that is now active

worktreeName.description: The directory name of the new active worktree

branch.description: The branch checked out in the new active worktree

previousPath.description: The workspace root path before the switch

throws.title: NoWorktreesError
throws.description: The project has no additional worktrees to switch to

throws.title: WorktreeNotFoundError
throws.description: No worktree matches the provided name, path, or branch

throws.title: AlreadyOnWorktreeError
throws.description: The current workspace is already the requested worktree

throws.title: SwitchFailedError
throws.description: The cursor-app-control MCP call to switch the workspace failed

examples.description: Switch to a worktree by name (inside Cursor)
Switch by branch name when running outside Cursor

prompts.name: createAndSwitch
prompts.description: Create a new git worktree (optionally on a new feature branch via the detached-HEAD-first technique), run worktrees.json setup hooks, and switch the active workspace to it in one flow

parameters.name: newBranch
parameters.description: Name of a new feature branch to create in the worktree. Created with the detached-HEAD-first technique (with automatic rollback if branch creation fails). Follow the feature/{environment}/{feature-name} convention where applicable. Mutually exclusive with branch.

parameters.name: branch
parameters.description: An existing branch name, tag, or commit SHA to check out in the worktree. Mutually exclusive with newBranch.

parameters.name: startPoint
parameters.description: Base commit/branch/tag the new branch starts from. Defaults to the current HEAD. Only meaningful with newBranch.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Short name for the worktree directory inside .worktrees/. Auto-derived from the branch if not provided.

parameters.name: skipSetup
parameters.description: Skip running worktrees.json setup commands after creation.

returns.description: Details of the created worktree and the switch operation

worktreePath.description: Full absolute path to the new worktree directory

branch.description: The branch checked out in the worktree

newBranch.description: Whether a new branch was created

switched.description: Whether the active workspace was switched to the new worktree

throws.title: WorktreesNotConfiguredError
throws.description: The project does not have .worktrees/ set up with the symlink

throws.title: BranchExistsError
throws.description: The requested new branch name already exists (the partial detached worktree is rolled back before this is returned)

throws.title: SwitchFailedError
throws.description: The worktree was created successfully but the cursor-app-control MCP call to switch failed. The worktree can still be entered manually.

examples.description: Create a new feature branch worktree and switch to it (inside Cursor)
Create a worktree from an existing branch and switch to it, outside Cursor

skills.name: setup-worktrees
skills.description: Configures Cursor git worktrees for a project by creating a local .worktrees directory and symlinking it into ~/.cursor/worktrees/. Handles migrating existing worktrees, creating worktrees.json with setup commands, and updating .gitignore. Use when setting up worktrees for a new project, migrating worktrees to a project-local directory, or configuring worktree setup hooks.

skills.name: create-worktree
skills.description: Creates a new Cursor git worktree from a branch or commit, places it in the project-local .worktrees/ directory, and runs worktrees.json setup commands. Use when the user wants to create a worktree, work on a branch in a separate directory, or spin up a parallel working copy.

skills.name: remove-worktree
skills.description: Removes a Cursor git worktree by name or path, cleaning up the directory and git metadata. Supports listing available worktrees for interactive selection. Use when the user wants to remove a worktree, clean up old worktrees, or delete a parallel working copy.

skills.name: merge-worktree
skills.description: Merges a worktree's branch into a target branch. Validates clean state, locates the target branch checkout, performs the merge, and optionally removes the worktree afterward. Use when the user wants to merge worktree changes back into main, dev, or any other branch.

skills.name: update-worktree
skills.description: Updates a worktree's branch to include changes from another branch using merge or rebase. Handles stashing, conflict detection, and recovery. Use when the user wants to pull in latest main, sync a worktree, or rebase a worktree branch onto another branch.

skills.name: switch-worktree
skills.description: Switches the active workspace to a different git worktree. When running inside Cursor, uses the cursor-app-control MCP server to redirect Cursor's UI and the default terminal cwd to the new worktree path. Outside of Cursor, prints the cd command for the user to run manually. Use when the user wants to switch worktrees, change to a different worktree, or move the active workspace to a parallel working copy.

skills.name: create-and-switch-worktree
skills.description: Creates a new Cursor git worktree (optionally on a new feature branch created with the detached-HEAD-first technique), runs worktrees.json setup commands, and then switches the active workspace to it. Use when the user wants to create a worktree and immediately start working in it.
